sermon.title: Before There Was an Earth
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer contrasts secular origin theories with what the Bible alone reveals about before the earth: Christ as Wisdom beside God (Proverbs 8), the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world, the church chosen in him, the kingdom prepared, and eternal life promised before time began. Since Jesus fulfilled the beginning promises, he will fulfill the end promises.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He says “John 14:31” then corrects to verse 3. The calling quote he gives as 2 Timothy 1:8 is 1:9–10. Earth speed figures (~1,100 mph rotation, ~65,000 mph orbit) are spoken and unchecked. Sensitive content kept as spoken: homosexuals and gender, atheism linked to university shootings, extreme environmentalists, young-earth 24-hour days, mountains under the flood waters, Jesus “created” in God’s plan (Revelation 3:14), the resurrected body having no blood, and Jesus growing back removed limbs of the maimed.

chunks.section_question: Does “not by works” mean you can live in sin?
chunks.short_answer: He says “works” there means ceremonial works of the shadow law—sacrifices, incense, tassels, food laws—not righteous living. People who think they can commit adultery, get drunk and rob and still go to heaven are wrong; those are harmful works.

chunks.section_question: Why must every church preach Christ?
chunks.short_answer: Christ abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel. With the internet there is no excuse—the church needs a vision to get the word out. Jesus fulfilled the beginning promises: virgin birth, wisdom at 12, preaching at 30, miracles, laying down his life and rising.

faqs.question: What do atheists treat as eternal?
faqs.answer: He says they claim dust and gas always existed—that is their eternal god.

faqs.question: What is science?
faqs.answer: Just knowledge—not a magic word for PhDs—and Bible knowledge is very powerful.

faqs.question: Why does he link atheism to mass shootings?
faqs.answer: He says humanists teach there is nothing after death and no punishment, so a killer thinks he can go out famously.

faqs.question: Was Jesus created?
faqs.answer: He says Jesus is eternal and wasn’t created from nothing; he was created in God’s plan to be the fleshly body born of a virgin.

faqs.question: Did God have a plan B when Adam and Eve sinned?
faqs.answer: No—Jesus was his number one plan and he had it figured out already.

faqs.question: What is the earth’s foundation?
faqs.answer: He says the earth is hung on nothing—a supernatural God.

faqs.question: What is peace?
faqs.answer: The absence of war or conflict; when you treat people right you have peace and joy.

faqs.question: How long was a day of creation?
faqs.answer: He says one rotation of the earth, 24 hours—not a thousand, million or billion years.

faqs.question: Who was eternal life promised to?
faqs.answer: To you—believers and followers—not to plants and trees.

faqs.question: What should you do when you fail?
faqs.answer: Get back up, admit you’re wrong, confess your sin, let him forgive you and get going again.
